items.t: Looks forward to developing early childhood education, described as an area of opportunity.
items.q: Early childhood education is an area of opportunity that then Rep. and now Lt. Gov. Luke looks forward to developing.

record.t: Unveiled the Ready Keiki initiative, the administration's plan to expand high-quality child care and preschool for 3- and 4-year-olds by 2032.
record.q: Lieutenant Governor Sylvia Luke today unveiled the Ready Keiki initiative, the administration’s multi-faceted plan to expand high-quality child care and preschool for 3- and 4-year-olds by 2032.

record.t: Serves as the 16th Lieutenant Governor of Hawaii.
record.q: Lieutenant Governor Sylvia Luke is the 16th Lieutenant Governor of the State of Hawaiʻi, the third woman to hold the office

record.t: Leads Ready Keiki, the state's plan to provide universal access to preschool.
record.q: Lieutenant Governor Luke is leading Ready Keiki , the state’s plan to provide universal access to preschool

record.t: Is spearheading Connect Kākou, the state's initiative to expand access to high-speed internet.
record.q: She is also spearheading Connect Kākou , the state’s initiative to expand access to reliable and affordable high-speed internet.

record.t: Served as a State Representative for House District 25.
record.q: awarded for her time as a State Representative, House District 25 – Maikiki, Punchbowl, Nuʻuanu, Dowsett Highlands, Pacific Heights, and Pauoa

record.t: Served as House Finance Committee Chair and supported library budgets.
record.q: Throughout her tenure in the State House of Representatives, then Rep. Luke supported library budgets to maintain library services and staff through her position as House Finance Committee Chair.
